 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ANJANI KUMAR SHARAN
ORAL ORDER 3 21-04-2023
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P. for the State.

The petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Sections 420,467,468,471,120B of the Indian Penal Code and section 30 (a) , 32(i) (ii), 36 and 41(i) of the Bihar Prohibition and Excise Act.

The allegation against the petitioner is that he is a member of syndicate for purchase and sale of illicit liquor Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.

He submits that no incriminating article has been recovered from the conscious physical possession of the petitioner rather 5392.440 liters of foreign made liquor is said Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.7742 of 2023(3) dt.21-04-2023 to have been recovered from the place of occurrence.
He submits that the petitioner has got three criminal antecedent of similar nature as stated in para-3 of the bail application.

Petitioner is agreed to deposit a sum of Rs. 4 lac (Rupees four lac ) in the account of Bihar State Bar Council Welfare Fund bearing Account No.31861041899, IFSC Code:
Chintu Kumar @ Chandra Shen Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/75787348/
1 SBIN0010340, State Bank of India, High Court Campus, Patna.
Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case, let the above named petitioner, be released on bail, in the event of his arrest or surrender before the learned Court below within a period of eight weeks from today, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Court below where the case is pending/successor Court in connection with Khodabundpur P.S. Case No. 260 of 2022, subject to the condition as laid down under Section 438 (2) of the Cr.P.C,
subject to the further conditions that (1) One of the bailors will be his own blood relative, preferably, father, mother, brother, sister and/or his wife.
